scope: Model forward over pre-tokenised windows only. Tokenisation, windowing and HTTP overhead are NOT included, so a real request costs this plus those.

caveats.batch_1_p95: 125.94 ms against a 15.16 ms median is the CUDA context and cuDNN autotune on first call, not a latency tail. Do not publish it.
caveats.saturation: Batch 1 and batch 2 take the same wall time, so batch 2 is nearly free. Past that, time scales linearly with batch and throughput is flat. The model saturates this GPU at 1024 tokens, which a GEMM-bound model would not.

_note: Transcribed from the pod terminal; the pod had no persistent volume. Every field appeared verbatim in the run's own JSON output.
